versionQuery: SELECT rdb$get_context('SYSTEM', 'ENGINE_VERSION') AS version FROM rdb$database

views: SELECT TRIM(RDB$RELATION_NAME) AS view_name FROM RDB$RELATIONS WHERE COALESCE(RDB$SYSTEM_FLAG, 0) = 0 AND RDB$VIEW_BLR IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1
triggers: SELECT TRIM(RDB$TRIGGER_NAME) AS trigger_name, TRIM(RDB$RELATION_NAME) AS table_name FROM RDB$TRIGGERS WHERE COALESCE(RDB$SYSTEM_FLAG, 0) = 0 ORDER BY 2, 1
routines: SELECT TRIM(RDB$PROCEDURE_NAME) AS routine_name, 'PROCEDURE' AS routine_type FROM RDB$PROCEDURES WHERE COALESCE(RDB$SYSTEM_FLAG, 0) = 0 AND RDB$PACKAGE_NAME IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT TRIM(RDB$FUNCTION_NAME), 'FUNCTION' FROM RDB$FUNCTIONS WHERE COALESCE(RDB$SYSTEM_FLAG, 0) = 0 AND RDB$PACKAGE_NAME IS NULL AND RDB$FUNCTION_SOURCE IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1
SELECT TRIM(RDB$PROCEDURE_NAME) AS routine_name, 'PROCEDURE' AS routine_type FROM RDB$PROCEDURES WHERE COALESCE(RDB$SYSTEM_FLAG, 0) = 0 ORDER BY 1
sequences: SELECT TRIM(RDB$GENERATOR_NAME) AS sequence_name FROM RDB$GENERATORS WHERE COALESCE(RDB$SYSTEM_FLAG, 0) = 0 ORDER BY 1

tableStatus.sql: SELECT TRIM(RDB$RELATION_NAME) AS table_name, CAST(RDB$DESCRIPTION AS VARCHAR(8191)) AS table_comment FROM RDB$RELATIONS WHERE COALESCE(RDB$SYSTEM_FLAG, 0) = 0 AND RDB$VIEW_BLR IS NULL ORDER BY 1
